changelog: **`/admin/matching` — matching rule sets and a dry run (#1783):** admins create, edit, set as default and archive their org's `MatchRuleSet`s (one row per criterion: weight slider, kind weighted / required / excluded, per-criterion settings — time-zone hours, minimum shared skills, respecting a mentor's "not taking mentees"), with a live preview of each weight's share of the score (whole percent, largest remainder, always 100). `GET/POST/PUT /api/admin/matching/rule-sets` + `DELETE …/[id]` (ADMIN checked in the handler, tenant-scoped, one writer `src/lib/matching/ruleSetStore.ts`: every edit bumps `version` and replaces the rules in one transaction, one live default per org, archive never deletes). `POST /api/admin/matching/simulate` scores an **unsaved** draft (shared zod schema `ruleSetSchema.ts`) for one mentee, a cohort or the unmatched mentees through the pure `simulateRuleSet()` (`src/lib/matching/simulate.ts`): top mentors with their breakdown, coverage (`X of Y mentees have an eligible mentor`), mentors at capacity, and the hard rule that eliminated the most. Read-only by definition — no relation, proposal, decision or feedback row is written. Shared loaders in `src/lib/matching/pool.ts`.

en: New Matching rules page: decide which criteria count and how much, mark rules as required, and try a draft on your unmatched mentees before saving it — it shows who would match whom and which rule is too tight.
tr: Yeni Eşleştirme kuralları sayfası: hangi ölçütlerin ne kadar önemli olduğunu belirle, kuralları zorunlu işaretle ve bir taslağı kaydetmeden önce mentörü olmayan mentee'ler üzerinde dene — kimin kimle eşleşeceğini ve hangi kuralın fazla sıkı olduğunu gösterir.
de: Neue Seite „Matching-Regeln“: Lege fest, welche Kriterien wie stark zählen, markiere Pflichtregeln und teste einen Entwurf an Mentees ohne Mentor, bevor du ihn speicherst — sie zeigt, wer zu wem passen würde und welche Regel zu streng ist.
